title: 皮革 Logo 烫金膜怎么选？

seo.title: 皮革 Logo 烫金膜怎么选？

content:
## 内容定位

用于回答真皮、PU皮、PVC人造革、植鞣革、油蜡皮、皮具 logo 烫金膜选型和测试问题。

## Reddit 英文短评版

For leather, I would first identify the leather type.

Genuine leather, PU leather, coated leather, vegetable-tanned leather and textured leather all behave differently. Test on scrap material first. Use three temperature points and keep pressure/dwell time consistent. After cooling, run rub and bending tests.

Do not judge only by how it looks immediately after stamping.

## PrintPlanet 技术长评版

Leather foil stamping requires a different approach from paper stamping.

The key variables are leather type, surface coating, texture depth, heat resistance and flexibility. Genuine leather can be sensitive to pressure marks and color change. PU leather can soften or deform under excessive heat. Coated leather may show poor adhesion if the foil adhesive layer is not compatible with the top coating.

A proper test should include:

1. Low, medium and high temperature points

1. Constant pressure and dwell time

1. Rub test after cooling

1. Bending test

1. Comparison between fine logo and solid mark

For production leather goods, adhesion after bending and rubbing is more important than the fresh stamping appearance.

## 知乎中文科普版

皮革logo烫金，不能只问“多少度”。因为真皮、PU皮、植鞣革、油蜡皮、压纹皮、涂层皮，表现都不一样。

真皮更怕压伤、变色和纹路不平。  

PU皮更怕温度过高后发粘、变形或掉金。  

油蜡皮和特殊涂层皮可能会因为表面油性导致附着力差。

建议测试方法：

1. 用边角料打样。

1. 做低、中、高三个温度点。

1. 每组保持压力和时间一致。

1. 冷却后做手擦测试。

1. 再做弯折测试。

皮革烫金不要只看刚烫完亮不亮，更要看耐磨和耐弯折。

## 阿里国际站成交版

For leather logo stamping, please confirm whether your material is genuine leather, PU leather, PVC leather, coated leather or vegetable-tanned leather.

Different leather surfaces need different foil grades and stamping parameters. We recommend testing on your actual leather sample before bulk production.

We can provide leather-grade hot stamping foil color cards and sample rolls for testing.

## 自然 CTA

Please send your leather sample and logo design. We can suggest a leather-grade foil for rub and bending tests.

## 关键词

leather hot stamping foil, PU leather foil, logo foil stamping leather, 皮革烫金膜, PU皮烫金, 真皮logo烫金, 皮具烫金膜
